tables.name: Targoth Naming Method
tables.description: Which naming method a Targoth settlement name uses. Each result is a naming method; its faces are its weight (starter weights 70% / 30%). Old, austere and durable names of high, remote and partly abandoned mountain country.

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: First element + second element as one word, e.g. Karhold, Skarnwatch.

results.name: Historical Founder
results.description: Founder's name + 's + a settlement feature, e.g. Varok's Gate, Thren's Watch.
